attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), built a local package repo at /srv/localrepo containing zsh (downloaded while remotes were still reachable), served it via httpd on port 80 (firewalld http service opened, SELinux relabeled to httpd_sys_content_t), and added /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP/localrepo. Then blackholed cdn.redhat.com (both A/AAAA) via /etc/hosts, verified the Red Hat CDN repos genuinely fail (curl connection refused / dnf makecache error), and successfully installed zsh with `dnf install -y zsh` sourced from the local-repo while remotes were unreachable. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id/service/data baseline, rebooted node1 with `systemctl reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified httpd active, local repo still served, zsh still installed, and remote CDN still blocked post-reboot.
